title: SKU lifecycle turnover and repurchase timing sheet
content:
Purpose:
This working sheet is intended to drive near-term repurchase timing decisions by SKU and region. Focus is on SKU lifecycle turnover (ageing/retirement), expected runway given current burn, and recommended order cadence to avoid cascade shortfalls during seasonal spikes.

Notes on methodology:
- Burn rate is measured as average GPU-hour consumption per day observed over the trailing 28 days (smoothed).
- Runway days = (current_units + committed_on_order - safety_buffer) / burn_rate. Safety buffer uses regional SLA tier: 10% for non-critical, 20% for critical customer regions.
- Suggested order qty rounds to procurement lot sizes per vendor (typically 8/16/32 units).
- Lead times are vendor-estimated transit + customs + site-staging (days). Risk level factors supply region concentration and vendor single-sourcing.

Table (columns):
SKU | region | current_units | committed_on_order | units_allocated_to_dedicated | avg_burn_gpu_hours_per_day | converted_burn_units_per_day (gpu-hours / 24) | safety_buffer_units | runway_days (calc) | vendor_leadtime_days | expected_arrival_date | suggested_order_qty | order_type | risk_level | notes

Rows:
A100-40GB | us-west-2 | 112 | 32 | 40 | 1,920 | 80 | 22 | 1.8 | 42 | 2026-01-14 | 32 | purchase | medium | High steady burn from batch training; commit to staggered arrivals (8/week)
H100-80GB | eu-west-1 | 48 | 16 | 28 | 1,536 | 64 | 10 | 0.94 | 56 | 2026-01-28 | 16 | purchase | high | Single vendor quoting long lead; consider partial lease
L40s-48GB | ap-northeast-1 | 72 | 0 | 16 | 384 | 16 | 8 | 4.0 | 21 | 2025-12-24 | 16 | lease | low | Good regional availability, use leases to smooth seasonal peaks
A10G-24GB | us-east-1 | 200 | 0 | 60 | 2,400 | 100 | 20 | 1.8 | 10 | 2025-12-13 | 64 | purchase | low | High spare capacity; prioritize other regions
RTX-8000 (legacy) | eu-west-1 | 36 | 0 | 12 | 120 | 5 | 6 | 6.0 | 7 | 2025-11-27 | retire/replace | retire | medium | Plan phased transition to L40s during next quarter
H100-80GB | us-west-2 | 8 | 24 | 0 | 256 | 10.67 | 2 | 2.9 | 42 | 2026-01-14 | 8 | purchase | high | Short-term top-up to support benchmarking workload

Summary insights (quick):
- Immediate attention: eu-west-1 H100 runway <1 day once committed allocations are considered; high-risk due to single-supplier lead time. Recommend split order and evaluate short-term leases (see linked leasing quotes).
- us-west-2 A100s: runway under 2 days but committed on-order arrival across 6 weeks; suggest breaking order into 2x16 to smooth arrival and reduce queue pressure.
- ap-northeast-1 L40s: comfortable runway; use leasing spot for expected December burst.
- Legacy RTX-8000 units: schedule controlled retirements; map replacements to procurement arrivals to avoid double spend.

Procurement cadence proposal (operational steps):
1) Create staggered orders for A100 and H100 with maximum tranche size 32 units to avoid single-week customs bottlenecks.
2) Open RFP for eu-west-1 secondary vendor for H100-compatible SKUs (deadline 2025-12-10).
3) Approve one-time short-term leases in eu-west-1 for 32 GPUs to cover a 45-day gap if vendor leadtime cannot be reduced.
4) Convert 25% of projected January burst in ap-northeast-1 to lease capacity; reevaluate by 2026-01-05.
5) Run weekly procurement sync with SRE and Console teams to reconcile demand forecasts and routing rules.

Risk register (top items):
- Vendor delay (eu-west H100): mitigation = secondary vendor + leasing + canary routing to us-west if network permits.
- Customs congestion in APAC holiday windows: mitigation = increase transit buffer by +7 days for orders placed Nov-Dec.
- SKU obsolescence for legacy RTX: mitigation = planned retirement schedule + reallocate spare capacity for migrations.

Action items (owners and due dates):
- Marcus Lee: open RFP for eu-west H100 backup (due 2025-12-03).
- Sofia Nguyen: scope leasing contracts and pricing scenarios (due 2025-12-05).
- Diego Martinez: update fleet allocation rules to preferentially route non-SLA traffic to A10G pool (due 2025-12-01).
- Aisha Patel: finalize staggered PO schedule and submit to finance for approval (due 2025-12-07).

Open questions / items for exec review:
- Approve one-time leasing cap of up to $250k for emergency fill in EU (approval requested).
- Accept higher inventory holding in us-west-2 for H100s to reduce cross-region failover latency tradeoffs.

Appendix: estimation examples and quick formulas used in the sheet:
- converted_burn_units_per_day = avg_burn_gpu_hours_per_day / 24
- runway_days = (current_units + committed_on_order - safety_buffer_units) / converted_burn_units_per_day
- safety_buffer_units = ceil(total_regional_units * safety_percent)

Change log (brief):

- 2025-11-27: added committed-on-order adjustments and lease scenarios (S. Nguyen input).
- 2025-12-03: updated vendor lead times after procurement vendor call (M. Lee)
